objective: Identify, evidence and reproduce the first complete high-salience homepage section after TCG Pocket as an independently testable source-calibration surface, then prove its learned section-local rules with one isolated held-out variation.
mustPreserve: the next section identity and boundary as actually rendered
visible parent/background/child stacking rather than inferred column fills
desktop 1440 and mobile 390 reading order and geometry
official asset identities and source hashes
observed typography roles and interaction states
page scroll continuity and prior Hero, What's New, TCG Live and Pocket sections
mustNot: choose a section from source-code naming or asset filenames before screenshot confirmation
treat hidden or dormant DOM as visible evidence
invent motion timing or interaction states
use source screenshots as runtime implementation assets
count source-observed responsive reflow as held-out generation
modify any Demo before Evidence, Interpreter and Design Direction gates pass

acceptance.evidence: Every high-salience claim has a visible screenshot region, live DOM bounding box, computed fact and source/asset trace; unresolved behavior stays unresolved.
acceptance.structure: Desktop/mobile section boundaries, stacking, reading order and responsive strategy are explicitly measured.
acceptance.visual: Background, principal assets, typography hierarchy and controls match the source at the same content viewport.
acceptance.interaction: Every visible control has a reproducible before/after or verified destination; page scrolling remains reversible.
acceptance.generative: A separate clearly labelled fictional fixture changes content or internal arrangement while preserving approved section-local invariants.
